title: Why Inovexa vs. Traditional ERP
lead: Legacy ERP projects take months and usually need extra work for local tax rules, several languages, and several currencies. Inovexa includes all three from day one.

title: Tax rules and currencies for every country you sell in
lead: Inovexa ERP supports custom tax rules and currencies for virtually every country.

c: Configure any tax rule: Tunisian TVA, European VAT, UK VAT, US sales tax, withholding taxes, excise duties, and country-specific exemptions. Update rates without code changes.
Multi-currency invoicing, real-time exchange rates, and consolidated reporting in any currency. Invoice in TND, EUR, USD, GBP, SAR, AED, and any other currency your customers require.
Pre-configured for local fiscal rules, e-invoicing mandates, and statutory reporting formats in dozens of countries. New jurisdictions added continuously based on customer demand.
